responsibility: Provides shared utilities for nice region diagnostics, including recovering the function parameter tied to a free anonymous region, substituting replacement regions into that parameter type, checking whether a conflicted anonymous lifetime appears in a return type, and recognizing special `self`-parameter cases.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `traits/util.rs`, which provides broadly reusable trait-system machinery, this `util.rs` is narrowly scoped to nice-region diagnostics: it recovers the HIR/function-parameter context for anonymous lifetime conflicts and checks return-type/`self` lifetime cases for lifetime error reporting.
